defect: lane mask shift amount wraps at three bits for the highest level
rationale: The shift amount level_i + 3'd1 is self-determined at 3 bits, so level 7 wraps to 0 and the mask becomes zero instead of all ones.

mutation.description: Sized the increment of the shift amount to the three-bit level instead of the wider shift result.

author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the Heaviside mask to eight lanes, registered it and added a lane count.

labels.note: The three-bit shift count wraps from seven plus one to zero.
